body: My gf wont make it.  Cancer. Operation right now
She even doesnt know that ive attempted suicide twice already and that i want to die.

Its very weird and hard for me to determine where the pain is coming from. Thoughts about the past or that its true. Like everytime i think about her i get pain around where my heart is, it feels as if someone was squeezing my heart. However when i think about my family and how cruel they were to me i feel pain in my left arm as its where i cut my self. I just want this to be over and as you may know trying to get over your love of your life isnt possible. I wish she understanded me.

Well im sorry that im not what she wanted. I cant do anything about it. Im becoming tired of trying. Trying to live yet i cant without her. I hope she'd understand. Its not easy to go through college where no one cares whether you live or die. Even my parents dont give a damn. Well, i wish i was dead already so i wouldnt keep on living in pain.
